policy: Model availability is not the same as free-GPU compatibility. Run the hardware preflight and benchmark before enabling a model for production.

models.name: Qwen3 4B Instruct
models.caveat: The initial worker uses FP16 Transformers inference and does not require bitsandbytes. GPU memory headroom, system RAM, runtime/library versions and provider availability affect success. The adapter requires a real Kaggle/Colab benchmark before being treated as production-verified. Qwen is unloaded before Wan video generation. The same local planner also produces three NELLWICK vertical Shorts blueprints from one brief; it returns scripts/shot prompts only, not finished video assets.
models.hardware_policy: Selected when total CUDA VRAM is at least 15 GiB; runtime also reserves GPU headroom and can offload model layers to system RAM.

models.name: Qwen3 1.7B Instruct fallback
models.hardware_policy: Selected by the worker when total CUDA VRAM is at least 8 GiB and below 15 GiB.
models.caveat: The worker uses Transformers FP16 inference with automatic device mapping and CPU offload where required. This smaller fallback may produce less detailed scripts and shot lists than Qwen3-4B. Benchmark on the actual notebook GPU before relying on it.

models.name: Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B
models.caveat: The model card quotes 8.19 GB for the native 1.3B model path, while current Diffusers pipeline documentation describes roughly 13 GB for its Wan T2V pipeline. Memory depends on implementation, resolution, frames, offloading and library versions. Use the 13 GB figure for conservative planning and benchmark on the allocated GPU. Text-to-video only in this adapter.

models.name: CogVideoX 2B
models.caveat: Quantization support and actual memory depend on the GPU, Torch, Diffusers and torchao versions.

models.name: CogVideoX 5B I2V
models.caveat: The repository lists low-memory Diffusers/INT8 options; test on the exact P100/T4 hardware before relying on it.

models.name: LTX-2.5
models.license: LTX-2.x Community License for model weights; Apache-2.0 for code
models.caveat: 22B model family is not suitable as the first free P100/T4 baseline. Review model licence separately from repository code licence.

models.name: Stable Diffusion XL 1.0 Base
models.hardware_policy: Single GPU with at least 12 GiB total VRAM; model CPU offload, VAE slicing and tiling are enabled. Two T4 GPUs are not treated as one combined GPU.
models.caveat: The queue and worker adapter are implemented, but image quality, peak VRAM, runtime and repeated-job stability have not yet been benchmarked on the user Kaggle T4 runtime.

models.name: Kokoro 82M
models.output: PCM 16-bit WAV at 24000 Hz; individual dialogue lines plus combined dialogue track
models.caveat: Local TTS only; uses preset voices and does not clone a character or actor voice. Output quality, speed and repeated-job stability need a live Kaggle benchmark. First use downloads weights from Hugging Face Hub; no hosted inference endpoint is called.

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5
models.recommended_configuration: 2B DiT with 0.6B or 1.7B language model; CPU offload/quantization according to official GPU compatibility guide
models.caveat: Official install documentation requires Python 3.11–3.12. Current Kaggle worker runtime observed by the user is Python 3.13, so this requires a separate Python 3.12 environment and a live T4/P100 benchmark before integration.

models.name: LTX-Video 0.9.6 distilled · experimental image-to-video
models.license: LTX-Video 0.9.6 model-specific Lightricks licence; review before commercial publishing
models.precision: FP16 path for T4 testing; upstream recommends BF16 for many variants
models.hardware_policy: Single GPU with at least 12 GiB total VRAM and CPU offload; no multi-GPU VRAM aggregation
models.caveat: Adapter is connected to storyboard source-image selection and the production queue, but actual model loading, FP16 support, VRAM peak, generation quality and T4/P100 runtime remain unverified. Experimental; not a production guarantee.

models.name: Microsoft Edge TTS (optional online voice service)
models.license: Unofficial client library; service and voice use governed by Microsoft's applicable service terms
models.output: MP3 dialogue lines, combined MP3 track, individual SRT and combined word-boundary SRT
models.caveat: Requires internet access from Kaggle/Colab and communicates with a Microsoft-hosted service. No API key is needed by this client, but this is not a contractual unlimited-use service, SLA or guaranteed commercial endpoint. Prefer local Kokoro if the service is unavailable or not approved for the use.

models.name: NELLWICK low-memory FFmpeg renderer
models.license: FFmpeg build is LGPL or GPL depending on enabled components; check the exact distributed build configuration
models.output: H.264/AAC MP4 episode masters, 9:16 vertical MP4 Shorts, optional burned SRT subtitles
models.hardware_policy: Runs sequentially on CPU with two threads; source media downloaded from Drive; rendered segments checkpointed to Drive.
models.caveat: Current output uses hard cuts, center crop, basic Ken Burns still motion and simple audio mixing. Face-aware reframing, advanced transitions, colour grading, Foley, music/SFX generation and lip-sync are not implemented.

models.name: MuseTalk 1.5
models.license: MIT code and model weights; NOTICE asks users to contact the HDTF dataset owner about commercialization of the training data. Review the full NOTICE and all third-party component terms before monetized publishing.
models.input: One approved project character portrait plus one dialogue/narration audio asset
models.output: 25 fps talking-character MP4 with generated lip motion and supplied audio
models.hardware_policy: Separate Python 3.10 environment with PyTorch 2.0.1 CUDA 11.8, MMCV 2.0.1, MMPose 1.1.0 and FP16 inference. Uses one GPU only; designed to test on a single 16 GB T4/P100. No multi-GPU aggregation.
models.runtime_note: First job clones repository, installs an isolated environment and downloads approximately 4 GB of model/support weights into Kaggle working storage. Reuse is possible during the same notebook session; a fresh Kaggle session may need to recreate/download them.
models.limitations: Talking portrait / face-mouth animation only. Does not animate body movement, cannot guarantee exact identity preservation, and can introduce face jitter or alter facial details. English dialogue/narration expected. Current worker limit is 0.8–60 seconds per shot.
models.caveat: No actual Kaggle T4 render has been verified yet. The official MuseTalk NOTICE flags a potential HDTF dataset commercialization issue; don't use its output for monetized publishing until that licensing question is cleared.
